sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Activated Kruglov's RFID keycard (RFID act.) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A personalized RFID card with a strict design. Now that it is activated, you can try to slip into the port.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
- This item is not lootable from players and can only be placed in a special item slot.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Used in the story chapter The Ticket
